name: Visual difference
description: A screenshot no longer matches its baseline. Either the interface changed or the baseline is stale.

name: Missing baseline
description: No committed baseline for this capture on this platform. The visual job fails rather than writing one and reporting success.

name: Application defect
description: Cases parked with test.fixme() against a defect in the application under test rather than in the suite.

name: Host unavailable
description: The public demo host shed the request. Infrastructure noise, not a product regression.

name: Timed out waiting for state
description: The application never reached the state the case was waiting for, within the timeout.

name: Assertion failed
description: An assertion about the application's behaviour did not hold. The most interesting category of the six.
